body:
fatbaby-core pod 19/19 on GKE prrject-fatbaby; PVC fatbaby-var = 20Gi GCE persistent disk seeded and sha-verified; image via Cloud Build; parallel run only (DNS/Ingress untouched, box still running). Box prwatch-body/pr-reaction-watcher found dead since 2026-09-14 (torn journal line), repaired on PVC copy. Cards 553/555/557 moved to pending.

title: FatBaby on GKE persistent disk, parallel run live
